name: vykoputo
description: Plain PHP web starter na sdíleném PHP hostingu (Blueboard) s GitHub Actions CI/CD.

scripts.copy-fonts: mkdir -p public/assets/css/fonts src/css && cp -R node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/. public/assets/css/fonts/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.css src/css/
scripts.copy-js: mkdir -p public/assets/js public/assets/css/images && cp node_modules/rellax/rellax.min.js public/assets/js/ && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js public/assets/js/ && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.css public/assets/css/ && cp -R node_modules/leaflet/dist/images/. public/assets/css/images/ && cp node_modules/lucide/dist/umd/lucide.min.js public/assets/js/ && cp node_modules/glightbox/dist/js/glightbox.min.js public/assets/js/ && cp node_modules/glightbox/dist/css/glightbox.min.css public/assets/css/
scripts.build: npm run copy-fonts && npm run copy-js && npm run optimize-images && npm run build-css
scripts.dev: npm run copy-fonts && npm run copy-js && npm run watch-css
